description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Traits Paradise-Touched, concentrate

You Re-sync in three actions rather than ten minutes, recovering 1 Bandwidth. This is an activity: once you begin it, taking damage or being targeted does not interrupt it, though anything that removes your actions before you finish does. Everything else about Re-sync is unchanged, including that doing it where people can see you makes them nervous.

cinderfall.incomplete: Once/encounter: Re-sync as a 3-action activity instead of 10 minutes. Re-sync's only numeric output is 1 Bandwidth recovered. No `SpecialResource` rule element exists anywhere in the corpus for Bandwidth -- confirmed corpus-wide (`grep -rl "\"key\": \"SpecialResource\"" site/data/cards/` returns zero hits), and the class card itself (`site/data/cards/classes/classes.paradise-touched.json:49`) ships `system.rules: []`. Same absence class as Cultist Zeal/Ironsight Drift/Fleshmancer Vitae.
